findings.text: the landed change removes watch_producers_under from tests/conftest.py while this module still imports it, so test_a_producer_is_bound_to_this_run_by_the_home_it_reports_into fails with ImportError; re-run in the reviewed tree at 86dd5d57 it reports 1 failed in 1.40s, and 86dd5d57 is already an ancestor of main where the same import at line 293 still has no provider.

the tests: line records the gate as "PYTHONPATH=$PWD <venv>/bin/python -m pytest ..." with a literal placeholder instead of the interpreter path, so the command as reported cannot be re-run and a reader cannot tell which environment produced the recorded 3 passed 1 skipped.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against f7f9e13f — 7c5f69b9 rewrites the conftest fixture and adds the measure module, 86dd5d57 adds the landed record, the figure and the plan's section 10 note, touching no plan meta; the deletion of watch_producers_under leaves an import of it in tests/test_watch_arming_isolation.py:268.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the fixture, the subprocess-pytest measure, the executed negative control and the foreign-home refusal; the manifest records the gate at 3 passed 1 skipped and negative-control.log shows 1 failed with both survivors named by pid.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a watcher started under a test session's temporary RECKON_HOME is terminated at teardown; tests/conftest.py:104 now resolves pids from the seat record's own crew/watch directory and tests/conftest.py:137 signals them, and the child-session measure shows the armed producer gone.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate ran at 7c5f69b9 with 3 passed 1 skipped, names its logs and quotes the executed negative control, but its tests: line carries a literal placeholder in place of the interpreter path.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared fence lists tests/conftest.py, tests/test_test_watchers_are_reaped.py, the landed evidence record, docs/figures/a-follower-outlives-its-monitor and docs/plans/a-follower-outlives-its-monitor.html, and every path in both commits lies inside them.

justifications.durability: reinstating the command-line pattern reddens the foreign-home assertion at tests/test_test_watchers_are_reaped.py:232 and removing the fixture's signal loop reddens the measure at tests/test_test_watchers_are_reaped.py:197, though the positive half of that pair echoes a pid the test itself wrote and the detector's sensitivity rests on the one recorded negative control rather than a control inside the measure.
justifications.evidence: the gate and the negative control are recorded in the run directory (gate-test-watchers.log at 7c5f69b9: 3 passed 1 skipped; negative-control.log: 1 failed naming pids 396241 and 396308) and the measure carries a record-based positive control at tests/test_test_watchers_are_reaped.py:190, but the manifest's recorded command is not runnable as written.
justifications.fit: the helpers at tests/conftest.py:48, tests/conftest.py:63 and tests/conftest.py:104 follow the module's existing idiom and introduce no name carrying a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/conftest.py:137 signals each pid reapable_watch_pids returns, and tests/test_test_watchers_are_reaped.py:197 shows the producer armed under the child's home is gone one second after that session ended, with the negative control naming what survives when the loop is removed.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the two commits lies inside the declared write paths, but the change deletes watch_producers_under from tests/conftest.py while tests/test_watch_arming_isolation.py:268 still imports it, so the consequence escapes the fenced surface.
